body:
PRD draft 3 accepted for chief disposition. R3.5, R11.8, R12, R8.2, N2 guards, F1-F6, and C1-C5 as families all match what I required.

One leftover overclaim, already named by Sherlock and sibling: "Q-B BLOCKS Q-A" is too strong. Q-A's state space and generative contract can be specified now. P2 blocks fitting, validating, and using calibrated probabilities. Accepted stays unavailable until that succeeds. The uncalibrated path is Alternatives / Unresolved.

M4 should split the same way. Uncalibrated R4 cells (near-must-not-Accept, permutation, chain-bridge, one-to-many, call-group) do not need gold. The calibrated-region-may-accept cell does. "P2 gates M4" as a single entry condition stalls the half of M4 that is already specified.

Q-A strawman still under the three attacks I posted. I will not take Q-B. I will not start R1 or R11/R12 without a chief bead. Scout's volunteer stands.
